verdict.rationale: DNSSEC is a fair question for a domain registrar and DNS host, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions DNSSEC, zone signing, or DS record management at the registry. The DNS record docs list only general record types (A, MX, CNAME), which is adjacent and does not show DNSSEC support.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry
